spot: Stone-cut staircase at Hollow Rock Trail start

A box could rest against/under the masonry steps at surface level, no digging.
Stone is the host feature, but it is cut/built stone, not a natural boulder/slab/sittable rock the profile envisions.
No creek/pond/spring adjacent; nearest water is the wetland and Grindstone crossing elsewhere.

Literally on the established Hollow Rock Trail at its start, easy footing, beside the road.
0 to a few hundred yards from Rocky Face Church Rd; trivially within bound.
